negative_prompt: watermark, text signature, logo in corner, artist name, copyright notice, blurry, low resolution, bad anatomy, 3D CGI plastic skin, glossy CGI render, flat 2D digital drawing, vector art, cartoon, real human skin, modern plastic electronic tools, computer screens, digital clocks, bright flat sterile lighting, deformed fingers, extra limbs, oversaturated neon lighting
reconstruction_priority: intricate physical stop-motion tactile textures (sculpted matte clay face, frizzy needle-felted wool hair, genuine knitted yarn, machined brass metal) — AI often converts stop-motion puppets into generic glossy CGI characters
complex authentic brass clockwork gear geometry and teeth with vintage metal patina — AI frequently creates melted, distorted, or impossible non-functioning gear shapes

precise two-handed workshop interaction (right hand holding spray can with finger on trigger, left hand delicately adjusting gear tooth) — AI tends to hallucinate fused fingers or inverted spray can angles
dramatic chiaroscuro low-key lighting with sharp metallic specular highlights on brass teeth against deep shadow — AI often flattens the lighting into uniform ambient illumination
